transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Um... hi. I guess... well, it's mostly some stuff at work. I've just been having trouble during these long sales strategy meetings we have. I keep getting up when I know I'm supposed to just stay seated. 

Um... like, even if it's just to refill my water or go pace by the printer for a minute, I just can't seem to stay in my chair. So... yeah. That's why I made the appointment.
When this happens, are you feeling worried or anxious about something in particular?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I'm anxious about anything. It's just... I don't know. I just get tired of sitting there, I guess.
Do you feel driven to get up even when you try to stay seated?
Um... I don't really know. I'm not sure what you mean by driven. I just... I try to stay in my chair, but I eventually just want to stand up. So I do.
When you get up from your chair, does it feel like a repeated urge you have to act on to relieve tension or discomfort?
Um... no, not really. I wouldn't say it's like a tension thing. I just... get restless, I guess. I just don't want to sit anymore.
Do you also find it hard to stay seated or still in other situations besides those meetings?

Um... yeah, mostly just those meetings. That's actually why I'm here. I just... I keep getting up during these long sales strategy meetings. I know I'm supposed to just stay in my seat, but... I end up getting up anyway. Like, just to refill my water or... go pace by the printer for a minute.
Have you had similar trouble staying seated or keeping your attention focused in other settings, like at home, in school, or in conversations?
Um... no, not really. Just... mostly the meetings. I mean, I guess I might get a little antsy sometimes, but... no, I don't think it's really an issue anywhere else.
When you get up from your seat, does it feel like you have to do it to prevent something bad from happening?
No. It's not like that. I just... get up.
Have you had trouble staying seated or still in other situations besides these meetings?
Um... like I said a minute ago, no. Not really. It's... mostly just those meetings at work. I don't really notice it anywhere else.
Did you have similar trouble sitting still when you were a child?

Um... yeah, I guess so. It started a long time ago. Way before high school. I just remember my elementary school teachers always saying I was smart but... I rushed through things. And I talked out of turn a lot. I'd forget my homework, and my desk was just... full of half-finished papers. So, yeah.
When you get up from the chair, does it feel like an urge you can’t resist?
Um... no. I wouldn't say that. I just... stand up. I don't really think about it that much.
Do these attention or restlessness problems also cause trouble for you in other parts of your life, like at home or in social situations?

Um... not so much at home. It's mostly just work. It's... started showing up in my performance reviews lately. And, um... there was a client complaint recently. Something about trust. It just... it makes me worry that I could damage my accounts. Even though I really do care about doing good work.
